check_inputs.name: check_inputs

input.samples: lambda wildcards: [f for s in config['samples'].values() for f in (s['fastq1'], s['fastq2'])]

check_inputs.shell: echo 'Checking inputs'; for f in {input.samples}; do echo Checking $f; gunzip -t "$f"; done; touch {output.done}

build_bowtie2_index.name: build_bowtie2_index
build_bowtie2_index.description: Build Bowtie2 genome index from decompressed FASTA.

fastp.name: fastp
fastp.description: Perform quality trimming and adapter removal for paired-end FASTQ reads.

remove_rrna.name: remove_rrna
remove_rrna.description: Remove rRNA reads using Bowtie2 alignment with built rRNA index.

build_star_index.name: build_star_index
build_star_index.description: Build STAR genome index using decompressed FASTA and GTF files.
build_star_index.run:
try:
    shell("""
        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module load star/2.7.10a
        mkdir -p {params.star_dir}

        STAR --runThreadN {threads} \
             --runMode genomeGenerate \
             --genomeDir {params.star_dir} \
             --genomeFastaFiles {input.fasta} \
             --sjdbGTFfile {input.gtf} \
             --sjdbOverhang 99

        touch {output.done}
    """)
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "processing", "failed")
    raise e

star_align.name: star_align
star_align.description: Align reads with STAR using genome index and filtered reads.

prep_circtools.name: prep_circtools
prep_circtools.description: Prepare STAR alignments and sample metadata for Circtools detection.
prep_circtools.shell: echo '🧩 Preparing circtools input files'; mkdir -p {params.outdir}; bash /beegfs/homes/wjcmellon/circtools.cloud/app/scripts/prep_circtools.sh run_output/alignment {params.outdir}; touch {output.done}

detect.name: detect
detect.description: Run circRNA detection using Circtools on aligned BAM files.
detect.shell:
source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module unload circtools || true
        module load circtools/2.0.3

 circtools detect @{input.samplesheet} -ss -T {threads} -an {input.annotation} -A {input.reference} -B @{input.bamlist} -fg -F -D -M -G -Nr {params.Nr1} {params.Nr2} -O ./run_output/circtools_ci -k
